# Emoji picker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/emoji-picker/

Search a curated set of Unicode emoji by a descriptive keyword. Build a small sequence and copy it into a post, message or caption.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Search for Nepal, code, love or celebration and combine the matching emoji.

## Limits and checks

Emoji appearance and availability depend on your device. The tool provides standard characters rather than custom downloadable stickers.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
